defects.description: American tree steps are not exported in position JSON or restored by import. Position cannot round-trip exact selected model through reload/new browser.
defects.reproduction: Default covered call; set Leg 2 style American; select 400 tree steps; Update position; Export position JSON. Export contains legs, market, scenario but no steps/model options. Switching back to 100 and updating changes displayed P&L.
defects.recommendation: Add validated modelOptions.steps to export/import and restore before valuing imported data. Verify across reload/import.

defects.description: Position import reads market.spot, elapsedDays and volatility shifts but ignores scenario.spot if distinct from baseline market.spot.
defects.recommendation: Restore and validate scenario.spot (or explicitly reject unsupported scenario keys).

defects.description: Official calculator description/directory links accessible OIC Options Calculator Tutorial. Archive description mentions video tutorial but archive inventory lacks URL/resource entry and does not preserve the tutorial itself.
defects.recommendation: Preserve accessible description/link/transcript and explicitly label video external if it cannot be saved; do not claim complete OIC educational-resource copy.
